events.statement: Standalone declarations and bootstrap become available.
Standalone APIs graduate to stable.
CLI generates standalone applications by default; this is not yet the decorator default.
Component, directive and pipe decorators default to standalone.
events.migration: ng update adds standalone:false to NgModule declarations.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Existing NgModule declarations require explicit standalone:false after migration.

events.statement: Reactive forms gain typed models; Untyped aliases preserve opt-out behavior.
events.migration: Use Untyped aliases during migration; opt into types incrementally.

developerImpact.benefit: Type checking catches invalid form values.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Nullability and disabled controls require explicit handling; template-driven forms are not made typed.

events.statement: Standalone migration schematic supports projects using 15.2 or later.
events.migration: Run conversion, module removal and bootstrap migration in order.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Manual fixes and verification remain necessary.

events.statement: hostDirectives composes host behavior at compile time.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Inputs and outputs must be exposed intentionally.

events.statement: Functional HttpClient configuration supports standalone bootstrapping.

developerImpact.benefit: Provider configuration can be colocated with bootstrap.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Interceptor and injector configuration still require migration review.

events.statement: Routes can lazy-load standalone component classes.
Standalone router APIs graduate with the standalone model.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Lazy loading and standalone maturity are separate concerns.

events.statement: CLI adds an experimental esbuild browser builder.
Experimental builder gains incremental rebuild and watch capabilities.
esbuild/Vite build pipeline reaches developer preview.
New CLI applications use the application builder with esbuild and Vite dev serving.
CLI offers migration of existing applications to the application builder.

developerImpact.benefit: Provides integrated browser/server tooling and modern output.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Custom webpack integrations need review; no build speedup is inferred here.

events.statement: Signals expose tracked state and computed derivations.
Core writable/computed signal APIs are stable; effect has a separate lifecycle.

developerImpact.tradeoff: State granularity and actual consumer design determine work; revision signals alone are not a full architecture.

events.statement: WritableSignal.mutate is removed.
events.migration: Use update with immutable replacement values.

developerImpact.tradeoff: In-place mutation code needs review.

events.statement: Effects are part of the preview reactive model.
Effect execution timing changes relative to change detection.
events.migration: Review effect ordering and tests; do not assume the old microtask timing.

events.statement: effect reaches stable status.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Scheduling semantics differ across preview versions; avoid using effects as derived-state storage.

events.statement: Client hydration reuses server-rendered DOM.
Hydration graduates from developer preview.

developerImpact.tradeoff: DOM consistency is required; CSR-only timings do not measure this capability.

events.statement: ngcc is removed; View Engine libraries no longer work.
events.migration: Upgrade or replace View Engine libraries with Ivy-compatible packages.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Legacy library compatibility is lost.

events.statement: Compiler supports required inputs.

developerImpact.benefit: Finds missing bindings at build time.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Adding required inputs can break consumer templates.

events.statement: DestroyRef exposes injectable destruction callbacks.

developerImpact.benefit: Allows cleanup registration near resource allocation.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Cleanup scope follows the injection context.

events.statement: Compiler supports built-in control-flow blocks.
Built-in control flow is stable.

developerImpact.benefit: Reduces structural-directive imports and exposes explicit tracking.
developerImpact.tradeoff: View reuse differs in some track/trackBy cases; migrate and test.

events.statement: Deferrable views provide trigger-based lazy loading.
Deferrable views are stable.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Loading behavior depends on dependencies and triggers; not a measured runtime gain here.

events.statement: Signal inputs are introduced.
Signal inputs are stable and migration tooling is available.

developerImpact.benefit: Exposes input values as tracked reads.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Consumers must call signal getters; migration can require manual fixes.

events.statement: Signal-based queries are introduced.
Signal query APIs are stable.

developerImpact.benefit: Makes query changes available through reactive values.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Required-query and query-timing semantics need review.

events.statement: Model inputs support signal-based two-way binding.
model API is stable.

developerImpact.benefit: Pairs writable component state with two-way binding.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Two-way contracts still require explicit design.

events.statement: Function-based output API becomes available.
output API is stable.

developerImpact.benefit: Declares component event contracts without EventEmitter construction.
developerImpact.tradeoff: output is not itself a signal; consumers still handle emitted events.

events.statement: Zoneless scheduling is available experimentally.
Zoneless moves to preview and its provider is renamed.
events.migration: Replace provideExperimentalZonelessChangeDetection with provideZonelessChangeDetection.

events.statement: Zoneless scheduling becomes stable.
Zoneless is the default; existing Zone applications need migration review.
events.migration: Retain provideZoneChangeDetection when preserving Zone behavior; review notification paths before removing Zone.

developerImpact.benefit: Allows explicit change notifications without Zone patching.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Libraries and mutation paths must notify Angular appropriately; benefits require measurement.

events.statement: Angular can schedule change detection for notifications originating outside the zone.
events.migration: Review tests that assume outside-zone updates never trigger checking.

developerImpact.benefit: Handles explicit notifications from outside-zone code.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Legacy scheduling assumptions can fail.

events.statement: New standalone CLI bootstrap configuration enables event coalescing.

developerImpact.benefit: Allows batching of some event-driven checks.
developerImpact.tradeoff: It changes scheduling configuration, not all existing projects automatically.

events.statement: Hydration can be deferred for selected server-rendered regions.
Incremental hydration is stable.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Requires SSR/hydration-specific validation; not exercised by the runtime benchmark.

events.statement: linkedSignal adds writable state linked to reactive sources.
linkedSignal becomes stable.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Reset and override semantics need deliberate design.

events.statement: resource and RxJS-oriented resource support are experimental.
Asynchronous resource APIs graduate to stable.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Experimental signatures changed; review exact target APIs.

events.statement: Signal Forms introduce signal-based form modeling.
Signal Forms graduate to stable.

developerImpact.benefit: Connects form state to the reactive model.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Preview examples may use superseded names; existing form migrations require review.

events.statement: Angular Aria introduces unstyled accessible UI patterns.
Angular Aria becomes stable.

developerImpact.benefit: Supplies interaction primitives while leaving styling to applications.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Accessibility of the complete application still needs testing.

events.statement: CLI adds experimental Vitest unit-test support.
Vitest becomes stable and the default for new CLI projects.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Karma/Jasmine projects are not automatically equivalent; migration needs verification.

events.statement: Template hot replacement is available experimentally.
Template hot replacement becomes stable.

developerImpact.benefit: Can preserve development state during edits.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Development feedback is separate from production runtime performance.

events.statement: Legacy control-flow directives are deprecated in favor of blocks.
events.migration: Use ng generate @angular/core:control-flow and verify tracking behavior.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Deprecation is not removal; this dataset does not invent a removal version.

events.statement: Webpack-based Angular build support is deprecated.
events.migration: Review the application-builder migration; custom builders need their own migration path.

developerImpact.benefit: Concentrates supported build evolution on the application builder.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Pinned historical webpack measurements remain valid historical observations, not native-default v22 evidence.

events.statement: OnPush becomes the component default; the previous Default strategy is named Eager.
events.migration: Use the v22 update guide; explicitly preserve eager checking where required and verify notifications.

developerImpact.tradeoff: In-place mutations and missing notifications can expose stale UI; no speedup is assumed.

events.statement: Host binding type checking is enabled by default.
events.migration: Fix newly exposed type errors; the release documents a temporary typeCheckHostBindings opt-out.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Upgrades can fail compilation until those errors are resolved.

events.statement: lastSuccessfulNavigation becomes a signal.
events.migration: Invoke lastSuccessfulNavigation() when reading its value.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Property-style consumers need updates.

events.statement: Legacy moduleId and custom interpolation component metadata are removed.
events.migration: Remove moduleId and migrate custom interpolation delimiters to the standard form.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Custom template delimiters require migration.

events.statement: enableIvy compiler option is removed because Ivy is the rendering engine.
events.migration: Remove the obsolete compiler option.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Configuration cleanup is required.

events.statement: NgSwitch comparisons use strict equality.
events.migration: Align case and expression types instead of relying on coercion.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Previously coercing cases can select a different view.

events.statement: Deprecated async testing helper is removed.
events.migration: Use waitForAsync.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Old imports fail after upgrade.

events.statement: BrowserModule.withServerTransition is removed.
events.migration: Provide APP_ID directly.

developerImpact.benefit: Uses the explicit application identity token.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Older SSR bootstrap code needs migration.

events.statement: TestBed.get is removed.
events.migration: Replace TestBed.get with TestBed.inject.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Legacy tests require changes.

events.statement: initialValueIsDefault is deprecated in favor of nonNullable.
events.migration: Replace initialValueIsDefault with nonNullable where equivalent.

developerImpact.benefit: A common name aligns reset behavior and typing.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Review reset-to-null expectations.

events.statement: The timezone-only DatePipe default token is deprecated.
events.migration: Move the timezone into DATE_PIPE_DEFAULT_OPTIONS.timezone.

developerImpact.benefit: One options object can express default configuration.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Provider configuration must be updated.

events.statement: EnvironmentInjector.runInContext is deprecated in favor of runInInjectionContext.
events.migration: Use runInInjectionContext(environmentInjector, callback).

developerImpact.benefit: The function makes the injector argument explicit.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Call sites need a function import and argument change.

events.statement: Direct ChangeDetectorRef.checkNoChanges usage is deprecated.
events.migration: Use ComponentFixture in tests; remove direct application calls.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Applications should not rely on this assertion API.

events.statement: HTTP configuration modules are deprecated in favor of provider functions.
events.migration: Migrate to provideHttpClient with matching features; retain DI interceptors explicitly when needed.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Interceptors, XSRF and JSONP options must be preserved.

events.statement: HttpResponseBase.statusText is deprecated.
events.migration: Review status-text dependencies and use numeric status or application response data.

developerImpact.tradeoff: Existing text-based handling needs review.

events.statement: this-qualified template reads no longer resolve local template-context variables.
events.migration: Remove this. when the intended value is a template local.

developerImpact.benefit: Explicit receivers distinguish component properties from locals.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Templates relying on previous shadowing behavior need changes.

events.statement: Templates support exponentiation and tagged template expressions.

developerImpact.benefit: Some expressions can be expressed directly in templates.
developerImpact.tradeoff: More expressive templates still require review for readability and evaluation costs.

events.statement: Comments can appear among element attributes and bindings.

developerImpact.benefit: Binding-specific notes can sit next to the binding.
developerImpact.tradeoff: This template syntax is version-specific and should not be assumed portable to older compilers.

events.statement: From v22, the documented major cadence is annual with a typical 24-month support window.

developerImpact.benefit: A longer major cycle can give upgrade teams more scheduling room.
developerImpact.tradeoff: Schedules remain guidance and older version support dates must be read individually.

examples.note: Alternative APIs within v14; imports omitted. nonNullable also changes reset behavior.
Migration snippet; items is a writable signal and next is a new item.
The after example targets stable control flow. NgIf import omitted in before.
Preserves an NgModule declaration after the default changes; class/imports omitted.

uncertainties.description: The v22.0.0 GitHub framework and CLI release endpoints returned HTTP 404; v22 claims use accessible official documentation/blog. Do not infer a tag record or release timestamp.
Feature timeline is selective. Compatibility source lists 22.0.x only although the live site reports newer 22.x builds; do not extend that row to all 22.x without a source.
Exact historical end-of-support dates for 14–19 are not transcribed; null means not collected, not still supported.
Live documentation can change. Support schedules are an as-of snapshot; month-only future dates retain their original precision.
Developer impacts are editorial interpretations of documented APIs. No claim here establishes a measured speedup.
Material/CDK details, every patch fix, resource preview signature changes and complete per-package breaking lists remain outside the curated feature set. Consult release notes and update guide.

No separate deprecation section was present in the reviewed v19.0.0 release record. This is not evidence that all 19.x APIs were free of deprecations; minor/patch lifecycle coverage remains selective.
